feature: Batch Release Dashboard — Quality Inspection Monitoring

envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-064-001.name: Valid Batch in Quality Inspection — Dashboard Access
TD-CS-064-001.expectedOutcome: Dashboard displays batch with QI status, process order, and days pending

TD-CS-064-002.name: Batch with Open Deviations — Drill-Down
TD-CS-064-002.expectedOutcome: Drill-down displays batch record with open deviation details

TD-CS-064-003.name: Batch Approaching Ship Date — Release Disposition
TD-CS-064-003.expectedOutcome: Batch is released; stock status updated to Unrestricted; available for SD

TD-CS-064-AP-001.name: Batch Reject Disposition — Stock Status Blocked
TD-CS-064-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Batch is rejected; stock status updated to Blocked; excluded from SD

TD-CS-064-AP-002.name: Batch Rework Disposition — Stock Status Remains QI
TD-CS-064-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Batch is flagged for rework; stock status remains Quality Inspection

TD-CS-064-AP-003.name: Batch with No Open Deviations — Drill-Down
TD-CS-064-AP-003.expectedOutcome: Drill-down displays batch record with empty deviation list

TD-CS-064-NEG-001.name: Empty Dashboard — No Batches in QI Status
TD-CS-064-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: Dashboard displays empty state message; no batch rows shown

TD-CS-064-NEG-002.name: Batch with No Associated Ship Date — No Priority Highlight
TD-CS-064-NEG-002.note: customerShipDateNull is intentionally blank — no ship date assigned
TD-CS-064-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: Batch displayed without priority highlight; ship date field is blank

TD-CS-064-NEG-003.name: Disposition Without Batch Selection — Validation Error
TD-CS-064-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: System displays validation error; disposition dialog does not open

TD-CS-064-ERR-001.name: Missing Batch Number for Drill-Down
TD-CS-064-ERR-001.note: emptyBatchNumber is intentionally blank to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-064-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error; batch detail screen does not open

TD-CS-064-ERR-002.name: Missing Disposition Selection
TD-CS-064-ERR-002.note: emptyDisposition is intentionally blank to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-064-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System highlights disposition field; prevents submission; error message displayed

TD-CS-064-EDGE-001.name: Batch with Zero Days Pending — Lower Boundary
TD-CS-064-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Dashboard displays batch with Days Pending = 0 without errors

TD-CS-064-EDGE-002.name: Batch with Overdue Ship Date — Past Date Boundary
TD-CS-064-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Batch displayed with highest priority highlight (overdue)

TD-CS-064-EDGE-003.name: Batch with Ship Date Today — Immediate Priority Boundary
TD-CS-064-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Batch displayed with immediate priority highlight (ship today)

TD-CS-064-EDGE-004.name: Batch with Future Ship Date — No Priority Boundary
TD-CS-064-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Batch displayed without priority highlight (ship date > 30 days)

TD-CS-064-INT-001.name: Released Batch Available in SD — QM → MM → SD Integration
TD-CS-064-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Batch released; stock status Unrestricted; batch available in SD for picking

TD-CS-064-INT-002.name: Rejected Batch Excluded from SD ATP — QM → MM → SD Integration
TD-CS-064-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Batch rejected; stock status Blocked; batch excluded from SD ATP

TD-CS-064-INT-003.name: Process Order Linkage — PP → QM Integration
TD-CS-064-INT-003.expectedOutcome: Dashboard displays batch with correct process order linkage
